text:
alex_sales: Hey team — kickoff w/ Nimbus today at 10am PT. Need alignment on sample data flow & blockers for the 2-week pilot. Can we confirm what they need for S3 vs VPC access? Their security says no persistent copy of PHI in our infra.

maria_se: For sandbox we usually ask for a 10–50 file sample (anonymized), or pre-signed S3 URLs that expire. If PHI can't leave their VPC, we can propose Private deployment or a VPC peering path + customer-managed KMS.

sam_solutions: If the customer refuses sharing, we can accept a representative synthetic set + a prompt bank for evals. For pass/fail we need labeled expected outputs or a rubric.

jess_cloudops: On connectivity: VPC peering requires networking approvals and route tables updates. For AWS we can request an interface endpoint or a temporary IAM role + presigned S3. KMS keys should remain customer-owned. HSM options are available on the Private SKU.

alex_sales: They asked about timing — how long to stand up a temp sandbox if we go with presigned S3 URLs?

jess_cloudops: Presigned S3 -> we can ingest once URLs + schema are provided. Typical small set ingest + indexing < 4 hours. VPC peering + infra config -> 48–72 hrs depending on infra approvals.

maria_se: Draft success criteria for the pilot: 1) Connect & ingest sample (no PHI persisted); 2) Run 200 eval prompts and meet quality gates (top-1 accuracy >= 85% on labeled set); 3) Latency 95th < 250 ms on proposed dedicated config; 4) Cost within the proposed pilot cap. Open to tweak thresholds per Nimbus' expectations.

sam_solutions: Also add a data-handling constraint: no request/response logs persisted beyond 7 days for the pilot, and disable KV cache for any requests containing PII. We'll include the eval rubric and pass/fail per intent.

alex_sales: Pricing Q from Nimbus: can they get a capped spend for the pilot rather than pure usage billing?

maria_se: We can offer a pilot flat: $2,500 for 2 weeks covering up to 100k tokens + infra. Overages billed at standard rates. Alternatively they can use credits. I'll prepare a small quote.

jess_cloudops: :white_check_mark: I'll need their security questionnaire answers by EOD tomorrow to avoid delays. Can we send our condensed pilot SQ (minimal) link? https://redwood.ai/security/pilot-quick-q.pdf

alex_sales: I'll ask Sagar at Nimbus to fill it out and supply either presigned URLs or VPC peering details. I'll paste any creds/URLs here.

sam_solutions: I'll prepare the eval harness and a short runbook + example prompts. Sample eval command: ```bash
./run_eval.sh --prompts sample_prompts.json --model redwood-ded-1 --out results.json
``` Will include scoring script and expected threshold.

deploy-bot: Provisioning job queued: sandbox-ingest-1950123456 started by jess_cloudops. ETA: 3.8h.

jess_cloudops: Next steps: Alex to collect presigned URLs or VPC connection info + completed SQ; Sam to attach eval harness and prompt set; Maria to send pilot quote. Sync tomorrow 10am PT? :calendar:

alex_sales: Confirmed. I'll update Nimbus and post SQ + URLs here when I have them. Thanks! :thumbsup:
